verdict.rationale: n8n documents a versioned public REST API (/api/v1) with a complete endpoint reference generated from an in-repo OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec, plus interactive playgrounds. That is the right surface for an agent to manage workflows programmatically. However, no evidence item names workflow create, update, or activate endpoints, so the specific operations in the story are only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of workflow create/update endpoints, a documented activate/deactivate endpoint, any agent-driven or hands-on corroboration, and an API stability/deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API

citations.quote: This section is the complete endpoint reference for n8n's public REST API, generated from the OpenAPI specification
The official n8n-io/n8n repository carries the n8n Public API's OpenAPI 3.0.0 specification
The n8n API comes with a built-in Swagger UI playground in self-hosted versions. This provides interactive documentation, where you can try out requests.
